tasks_completed.description: R3 Step 1: Added navigation stack (history, push, pop) to rightSidebarStore.ts
tasks_completed.changes: Added history array, push() saves current data to stack and shows new, pop() restores previous or closes. open() clears history. close() clears all. Exported SidebarData interface.
tasks_completed.rationale: Enables sub-tool clicks inside sidebar to push new views onto a stack instead of navigating away

tasks_completed.description: R3 Step 2: Added back button to RightSidebar.tsx header when history exists
tasks_completed.changes: Added SidebarBackButton component with arrow-back icon. SidebarHeader now accepts hasHistory and onBack props. Back button shown before tool name when history.length > 0. Both MobileSidebar and DesktopSidebar pass through history/pop.
tasks_completed.rationale: Provides visual back navigation within the sidebar stack

tasks_completed.description: R2: Enhanced SidebarAgentConversation with prompt display, all message kinds, and sub-tool push
tasks_completed.changes: 1) Added prompt section at top with chatbubble-outline icon and MarkdownView for tool.input.prompt. 2) Extracted ChildToolBlock (uses push for sub-tool navigation), ChildEventBlock (gray italic text for agent-event), ChildUserTextBlock (surfaceHighest background for user-text). 3) Result section already existed. 4) ToolView in sidebar no longer passes sessionId/messageId, instead passes onPress and onContentPress callbacks that call push().
tasks_completed.rationale: Shows full agent conversation context and enables sidebar-internal navigation for sub-tools

dev.qa_notes: Verify in browser: 1) Open an Agent/Task tool in sidebar - prompt should appear at top. 2) Click a sub-tool inside the sidebar - should push new view with back button. 3) Click back button - should return to previous view. 4) agent-event messages should show as gray italic. 5) user-text messages should have distinct background. 6) Escape key still closes sidebar. 7) Test on both desktop and mobile viewports.
dev.implementation_notes: TDD skipped: pure UI rendering changes not programmatically reproducible without browser. All theme colors used (textSecondary, surfaceHighest) are verified to exist in theme.ts. The onContentPress callback type in ToolView matches SidebarData structurally.
